title: Get a plain-English explanation from a pasted notice
description: A visitor can paste a Social Security overpayment notice, request an explanation, and receive a plain-English summary with key details and a draft response letter.

steps.description: Navigate to /analyze
Fill in the notice text field with a complete overpayment notice message
Click the button to explain the notice
Verify a plain-English summary is displayed
Verify overpayment details, important dates, response options, and a draft response letter are displayed

title: Analyze a pasted notice and review the full summary
description: A user can paste a Social Security overpayment notice, request an explanation, and see the plain-English summary, key dates, response options, and draft response letter.

steps.description: Navigate to /analyze
Fill in the notice text field with a complete Social Security overpayment notice
Request an explanation
Verify a plain-English summary is displayed
Verify the overpayment amount, key dates, response options, and draft response letter are displayed

title: Analyze an uploaded notice file and review the results
description: A user can upload a supported notice file, request an explanation, and see the analyzed notice summary and response details.

steps.description: Navigate to /analyze
Upload a supported notice file
Request an explanation
Verify a notice summary is displayed
Verify response details and a draft response letter are displayed

title: See the guest limit after one successful analysis
description: A guest can complete one analysis and then receives the one-analysis-per-day limit message on a second attempt with a prompt to sign in free.

steps.description: Navigate to /analyze
Fill in the notice text field with a complete overpayment notice message
Click the button to explain the notice
Verify an analysis result is displayed
Fill in the notice text field with a different complete overpayment notice message
Click the button to explain the notice
Verify a daily analysis limit message is displayed
Verify a prompt to sign in free is displayed

title: Review account details and saved analysis history
description: A signed-in user can open the account page and view their plan information, remaining analyses, and saved analysis history.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Open the test code sign-in flow
Fill in the test code field with a valid test code
Submit the test code
Click the link to open the account page
Verify plan information is displayed
Verify remaining analyses and saved analysis history are displayed

title: Sign in with a test code and review account details
description: A demo user can open the test code flow, sign in with a valid code, and see plan details, remaining analyses, and saved analysis history in the account area.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Open the test code sign-in flow
Fill in the test code field with a valid code
Submit the test code
Navigate to /account
Verify plan details are displayed
Verify remaining analyses and saved analysis history are displayed

title: Use a sample notice to see an explanation
description: A visitor can load the sample notice on the analysis page, explain it, and review the sample result.

steps.description: Navigate to /analyze
Click the option to try a sample notice
Verify the sample notice text is populated
Click the button to explain the notice
Verify a sample plain-English summary is displayed
Verify a draft response letter is displayed

Open the test code sign-in flow
Fill in the test code field with a valid test code
Submit the test code
Verify the signed-in account experience is displayed

title: Request a sign-in link from the login page

Fill in the email field with a valid email address
Request the sign-in link
Verify a sign-in request status message is displayed

Verify the unauthenticated experience is displayed
